items.summary: Legal/compliance disposition: conditional for ordinary reversible growth; blocked for SearchWoot public beta, monetization expansion, and go-live. Evidence: compliance baseline is 35 pass, 20 fail, 6 unknown; security and operations evidence are unavailable; Amazon reports $4.92 aggregate commission that cannot be assigned to a site; and SearchWoot has 0/4 legal tasks evidenced closed. Keep SearchWoot private, leave rights outreach unsent, reject the four new control-plane proposals this cycle as capacity-incompatible, and permit only bounded reversible work that adds no new data collection, permissions, credentials, dependencies, or cross-site behavior. Human counsel is required for Woot redistribution/commercial-use rights, privacy/jurisdiction treatment, notification data, vendor/DPA obligations, and any future affiliate or advertising use.

Continue the active SearchWoot launch-readiness workstream. Progress is 0/4 legal tasks evidenced closed. Do not close any task on current evidence. Next evidence action: produce one dated read-only bundle from the existing repository/config artifacts covering source rights, data flow and retention, consent/GA4 configuration, logs/vendors, incident handling, deletion/correction, and notification workflows; preserve missing items as open and escalate rights, privacy, and vendor questions to human counsel.

Keep SearchWoot private. Before any public beta or production exposure, provide dated evidence for source refresh and stale-data handling, correction/takedown, rollback, security controls, and release validation. Existing public API documentation proves access mechanics only and does not prove redistribution or commercial-use rights.

Preserve the attribution boundary. Do not assign Amazon's $4.92 aggregate commission to any site or claim revenue, ROI, margin, or causal lift. Future affiliate links must use registered site tracking IDs and retain disclosure evidence.
